description: Aggregated DAG health: success-rate over the last N runs + count breakdown (succeeded/failed/queued) + average duration + last-failed-run id + (optional) failing task instances. Replaces the airflow-list-runs + airflow-get-task-instances combo for 'is this DAG healthy right now?'.

extractFields.description: Comma-separated dotted paths to project from response (e.g. 'id,name,owner.name,columns.*.name'). Use `*` as wildcard for arrays/objects. Wrap field names with dots in backticks. Reduces response tokens dramatically on large entities.

includeFailingTasks.description: If true, fetch task instances for the most recent failed run

name: dag-health-rollup
